column1: # go-test-weights.tsv - per-package `go test -race` wall-clock, in seconds.
# Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored by the reader.
# Consumed by scripts/ci/go-test-shards.sh to balance the CI shards. These
# weights are a HEURISTIC ONLY: a package missing here is simply assumed cheap,
# and a stale number costs balance, never correctness - the package universe is
# recomputed from `go list` on every run and `go-test-shards.sh check` fails the
# job if any package would go unrun.
# Source (lane CICD, 2026-11-01): the 2026-10-29 table (lane TESTCI, item 7
# of the test-time plan) put cmd/observer at 1690 s, cmd/observer-org at
# 2035 s and tests/e2e/orgserver at 387 s; the two full release-gate runs
# measured them at 4978 / 3895 / 2751 s, so LPT stacked observer-org and
# e2e/orgserver in one shard and the slowest shard ran 96 min against 29
# (the max per package) over runs 41274192950 (v1.37.0, 101a900f3) and
# 41246980707 (7d8f2d643), both workflow_dispatch FULL runs with -race on
# the concurrent list and checkptr off for modernc.org. A package neither
# run reported keeps its 2026-10-29 value. Packages too big for one shard
